sloka: तेन एवम् उक्तः शैलेन्द्रः सर्व एव त्वत् आश्रयाः ।मत् प्रसादात् भविष्यन्ति दिवा रात्रौ च कांचनाः ॥४-४२-३९॥
transliteration: tena evam uktaḥ śailendraḥ sarva eva tvat āśrayāḥ ।mat prasādāt bhaviṣyanti divā rātrau ca kāṁcanāḥ ॥4-42-39॥

translations.english: 'The Sungod said to mount Meru, 'By my grace all the trees and hillocks of this king of mountains will shine in golden red, the gods, gandharvas and demons who dwell here will have golden radiance '.
